breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and periodic conditions. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly omitted the contradictory periodic boundary condition and only described the Dirichlet condition, thus resolving the inconsistency.
